brief: Build a small Python module that validates Brazilian CPF numbers, with pytest tests covering valid and invalid cases.
Create a Python utility slugify(text) that lowercases, strips punctuation, and joins words with hyphens. Include a short README and tests.
Implement a minimal todo list stored in a local JSON file with add/list/done commands and basic tests.

Create an Instagram campaign for a new cold-brew coffee brand aimed at remote workers. Produce 3 posts: (1) single image hook about afternoon energy crash, (2) carousel explaining 3 brew tips, (3) Reel script teaser for a 15s behind-the-scenes. Include captions, CTAs, hashtags, alt text, and detailed image/video prompts. Write packages under posts/.

Create a LinkedIn campaign for a B2B SaaS analytics product aimed at engineering managers. Produce 3 posts: (1) text thought-leadership hook about vanity metrics, (2) single_image post with a visual prompt for a dashboard screenshot style graphic, (3) carousel_document with 4 slides teaching a simple KPI framework. Include hooks, body copy, CTAs, restrained hashtags, and write packages under linkedin_posts/.
